app.title: Qanoun
app.description: Browse Moroccan law and ask questions — answers grounded in official texts.
app.footer: An open-source project combining data engineering, AI and Moroccan law.

home.heroSubtitle: Family Code, Labour Code, the D.O.C. and more — read, indexed and question-ready.
home.askPlaceholder: Ask anything: marriage, divorce, work contract, lease…
home.topicsSubtitle: Start where it matters to you
home.how1Body: Official texts are fetched, Arabic PDFs parsed, segmented into articles and stored with a vector index.
home.how2Body: Semantic + full-text search fused together: the right article even when the question is in Darija.
home.how3Body: The AI answers only from retrieved passages, with a citation to the exact article.
home.disclaimer: Informational only — not legal advice. The official bulletin remains the reference.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: Qanoun processes personal data in accordance with Moroccan Law No. 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data, and the rules of the CNDP (Commission nationale de contrôle de la protection des données à caractère personnel).
privacy.controllerUnset: The operator of this server has not published its identity yet.
privacy.cndpPending: Not yet published by the operator of this server.
privacy.collectNoAccount: Without an account: nothing is tied to you. Your questions are processed only to answer them, and your conversations stay in your own browser or phone.
privacy.collectAccount: With an optional account: your email, your password (stored only as a salted hash), the conversations and settings you choose to sync, your API keys (stored only as hashes) and your sign-in sessions ({days} days). Purpose: to sync your conversations and settings across devices.
privacy.collectLogs: Usage statistics: one anonymous line per question (timing, outcome, sources used), with no IP address and no account. The question text itself is {logged}. These lines are deleted after {days} days.
privacy.notLogged: not kept (only a fingerprint used to count repeats)
privacy.collectAbuse: Abuse prevention: your IP address (or Telegram chat number) is used for a few minutes to limit the number of requests, then deleted.
privacy.transferTitle: Who receives your questions — including outside Morocco
privacy.transferIntro: To write an answer, the text of your question and the retrieved legal articles are sent to an AI service. On this server, these services are:
privacy.transferNone: No outside AI service is configured: questions are processed on this server.
privacy.transferLocal: A local model can also be used, in which case the question does not leave the server.
privacy.transferWarning: These services are located outside Morocco (art. 43–44 of Law 09-08). Do not include names, identity numbers, addresses or other personal details in your questions.
privacy.noSale: Your data is never sold, nor used for advertising.
privacy.retention: Account data: until you delete your account. Sessions: {days} days. Usage statistics: {logDays} days. Abuse-prevention counters: a few minutes.
privacy.rights: Under Law 09-08 you have the right to be informed, to access your data (art. 7), to have it corrected or deleted (art. 8) and to object to its processing (art. 9).
privacy.rightsHow: In Settings, signed in: «Download my data» gives you everything we keep about your account, and «Delete my account» erases it immediately. For any other request, write to the contact above.
privacy.complaint: You can also file a complaint with the CNDP: www.cndp.ma.
privacy.security: Passwords are stored with scrypt; sessions and API keys only as SHA-256 hashes; the session cookie is httpOnly; requests are protected against cross-site forgery and rate-limited.
privacy.unavailable: The server's details could not be loaded right now; the general rules above still apply.
